notes.text:
1. ANALYTICAL 3D OBJECTS
Six TZYX volumes of separate 3 x 3 x 3 cubes. Z/Y/X sampling is 1.5/0.5/0.4 micrometers and the time interval is 2.5 seconds. Original integer labels are an authored phantom, not biological segmentation evidence.

2. EXPLICIT PER-FRAME SEGMENTATION
Threshold > 0 intentionally discards the supplied label numbers. Label Connected Components creates fresh frame-local IDs for each 3D volume; it does not connect objects through time. Cube geometry and centroids remain unchanged. When C appears before A in voxel order, A's local label ID changes.

3. KNOWN CENTROIDS
Per-frame object counts: 2,2,1,3,3,3 (14 observations). A moves one Z and X sample per frame; B moves one X sample and is absent at T=2; C first appears at T=3. Measure Objects supplies t_index, local label_id and full-volume index centroids, not per-Z-slice rows.

4. PHYSICAL ASSOCIATIONS
Link with two micrometers per elapsed frame and at most one missing frame. Expect three tracks with 6,5,3 observations. A's per-frame displacement is sqrt(1.5^2 + 0.4^2) micrometers; B's is 0.4. The B gap spans two intervals. No interpolation, split/merge lineage or confidence score is claimed.

5. CHECK BOTH OUTPUTS
Tracked observations retain every measured row and add track IDs, displacement, speed and review flags. The separate Track summary reports durations, path lengths and gap counts. Source-index centroids plus carried origin/scale drive the geometry; historical measurement physical-centroid columns have their existing meanings. This example writes no files.

UNCHANGED SUMMARY HANDOFF
This Select Table Columns node keeps every summary column (auto = all) without calculation or aggregation. It exposes the second Build Tracks output as its own primary node result for generated Python and downstream table/export workflows. The source Track summary port remains separately inspectable.
